name: Cheque Party Role 1 Code
definition: Specifies the roles of the parties linked to a cheque.

DWEA.name: Drawee Agent
DWEA.definition: Specifies the agent on which a cheque is drawn, that is the financial institution that services the account of the payee that issued the cheque.

DWRA.name: Drawer Agent
DWRA.definition: Specifies the agent servicing the account of the cheque payer.

PAYE.name: Payee
PAYE.definition: Party that receives an amount of money as specified in the cheque.

PAYR.name: Payer
PAYR.definition: Party that issues a cheque ordering the drawee agent to pay a specific amount, upon demand, to the payee.
